home.setup.item.models.title: AI models & providers
home.setup.item.models.body: Connect at least one provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama…) and enable the models you want to use.
home.setup.item.projects.title: Projects
home.setup.item.projects.body: Create a project for work, home, or clients so conversations and agents have the right context.
home.setup.item.prompts.title: Base prompts & personality
home.setup.item.prompts.body: Review the master prompt and agent personas so tone, rules, and skills match how you work.
home.setup.item.agents.title: Agents & team
home.setup.item.agents.body: Enable or customize the assistant agents that will handle tasks and delegation.
home.setup.item.channels.title: Primary agent communication
home.setup.item.channels.body: Connect at least one channel (Telegram, Slack, email…) and bind it to your primary agent so you can message EYAS outside the web UI.
home.setup.item.search.title: Directories to index
home.setup.item.search.body: Add code or document folders under Search so agents can find files with full-text / semantic search.
home.setup.item.memory.title: Memory vault
home.setup.item.memory.body: Open the memory vault and seed notes, projects, or procedures you want the assistant to remember.
home.setup.item.backup.title: Backups
home.setup.item.backup.body: Create a first backup (and later schedule one) so SQLite, vault, and keys can be restored.
home.setup.item.ingress.title: Remote access (Ingress)
home.setup.item.ingress.body: Optional: expose EYAS securely via tunnel when you need access away from this machine.
home.setup.item.autonomy.title: Autonomy & self-improvement
home.setup.item.autonomy.body: Optional background loops (heartbeat, reflection, Forge, self-learning) — off by default; enable only what you want.
